messages:
Aisha (AE): Hey team — Solasta Systems exec just pushed for a go/no-go this week. POC is green on model quality but blocked on capacity + final pricing. need an exec-level unblock.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Quick summary: they want Dedicated pool size defined (approx 8x A100 equiv) + a one-off promo on committed monthly price. Technical ask: KMS BYO + private VPC peering.
Priya (Sales Eng): Legal pinged on data residency clauses and encryption-at-rest proof. Claire, any chance to fast-track their redlines? 
Claire (Legal): I skimmed the redline. Three asks: stricter data handling appendix, SOC2 evidence, and a KMS attestation addendum. I can do the appendix this afternoon if someone confirms the SOC2 artifact link.
Sam (VP Sales): We need a pricing decision. If we give a 25% intro discount for first 3 months and guarantee dedicated pool availability, do we have ops signoff? That will buy us exec commitment.
Jordan (Product): On capacity we can reserve a dedicated cluster but need SRE to confirm provisioning lead time and eviction/fallback policy. Fallback to hosted model must be documented for them.
Riley (SRE): Provisioning estimate for a new dedicated pool: 48-72h once hardware assigned. If it's a reserved contract we can pre-allocate. Also need network diagram from the customer for peering.
Aisha (AE): @Riley can we do a soft reserve this week so they don't pull the plug? Customer timeline: exec decision meeting Friday EOD.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Also they asked about throughput SLO during peak batch inference. Empirically, config X gives ~120 req/s with 128-token avg. I'll paste the perf snippet shortly.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): ```
# perf estimate
model: redwood-7b-quant
dedicated_nodes: 8
avg_tokens: 128
est_throughput: 110-130 rps
```
Priya (Sales Eng): @Sam if we can't match 25% discount, what is the minimum to keep the deal momentum?
Sam (VP Sales): Minimum is 15% with a playbook: 3-month intro discount + 6-month committed term. Need Finance okay.
Claire (Legal): I uploaded SOC2 snapshot to the internal share: https://redwood.internal/soc2-v2 (link). Will draft the KMS attestation today.
Riley (SRE): Adding note: BYO KMS supported via our connector but requires 1 week for key rotation policy config and trust testing. If they need faster, we can scope a temporary exception with stricter logging.
Aisha (AE): Ok action items: 1) Claire finalize redline by 5pm today. 2) Riley confirm soft reserve feasibility + timeline. 3) Finance to greenlight discount band. 4) Miguel to send perf estimates and peering checklist. Who owns the exec call prep?
Sam (VP Sales): I will join exec call, Miguel and Priya should prep a one-slide summary for Friday. Finance: @Jordan please loop in pricing ops.
Jordan (Product): Looping Pricing Ops — we can approve 20% once SRE confirms reservation and Legal signs KMS addendum.
ops-bot: New task created: #project-solasta-poc - assignees: Aisha, Miguel, Claire, Riley. Due: 2026-03-27.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Sending peering checklist now: IP ranges, cidr, BGP ASN (if applicable), cert fingerprints.
Priya (Sales Eng): Customer asked about SLA credits. Can we commit to an uptime SLA for the dedicated pool during the trial?
Riley (SRE): For trials we typically offer best-effort availability; SLA would require formal capacity reservation + support uplift. If Sales wants SLA we need to mark as paid reserved cluster.
Aisha (AE): Customer exec prefers SLA. This is why they want the discount plus reserved capacity.
Sam (VP Sales): Final ask: Can Legal, SRE, and Pricing come to a quick sync at 3:30pm PT to sign off on proposed terms? If yes, I'll schedule the exec call for Friday 10am PT.
Claire (Legal): I can make 3:30.
Riley (SRE): I'm in.
Jordan (Product): I'll be there for pricing ops.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll prep perf numbers and peering checklist before the sync.
Aisha (AE): Thanks everyone — please post confirmations here after the 3:30 sync. I'll update the customer thread. :pray:
